== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
Bantha initially places itself in Used Pile during your turn to take Bantha Herd into hand. The later slip uses a deploy-phase Reserve Deck deployment without the self-payment. Tusken Raiders are affected here in the revised wording. Both versions carry two riders, give half ability, move as a react and exempt creature vehicles from the stated Scum And Villainy condition.
